issues.title: WebApp Server Connection Failure
issues.description: Test server starts and displays startup messages but HTTP clients cannot establish connections. All requests fail with ECONNREFUSED.

analysis.rootCause: Terminal output interleaving in VS Code caused apparent connection failures
analysis.actualCause: Server was working correctly. The issue was VS Code terminal output mixing between background server and curl commands, making it appear the server crashed.

resolution.actualFix: Use Start-Job in PowerShell to run server in background process, preventing terminal output interleaving

issues.title: Missing Environment Variables
issues.description: Critical environment variables BOT_TOKEN and SUPABASE_URL are not set in the development environment.

impact.developmentImpact: unit tests pass due to mocks

resolution.suggestedFix: Create .env file with BOT_TOKEN=xxx and SUPABASE_URL=xxx

issues.title: Unmet Optional Dependencies
issues.description: Optional dependencies better-sqlite3 and canvas are not installed.

issues.title: Signup Button Not Working on Login Page
issues.description: Clicking the 'Sign Up' button on the login page did not switch to the signup form. The form remained on the login view.

steps: Observe: form does NOT switch to signup view

analysis.rootCause: JavaScript error: Identifier 'supabase' has already been declared
analysis.actualCause: The Supabase SDK (UMD module from CDN) creates a global 'supabase' object. The inline script then tried to declare 'let supabase = null' which conflicts with the global, causing a JavaScript error that prevented all event listeners from being registered.

resolution.actualFix: Renamed 'let supabase = null' to 'let supabaseClient = null' and updated all references throughout login.html
resolution.verifiedWith: Browser testing - tab switching works, signup form submits correctly
